title: Highly Stylized
description: A HIGHLY STYLIZED look (front) is what artist Phillipe Druillet sought in this poster concept bending the lines of Darth Vader's helmet to turn it into a near pyramid shape. The legion of stormtroopers seem carved out of stone. Conceptual artist Ralph McQuarrie also had a go at creating a poster. Here is one of his many versions (back)incorporating the first typeface used for the STAR WARS logo, before the now familiar triangular style was adopted.
